name: Bob's Coffee - Alerta diaria de stock mínimo

parameters.query: SELECT s.nombre, s.unidad_base, ROUND(s.stock_actual,0) AS stock, ROUND(s.stock_minimo,0) AS minimo, ROUND(COALESCE(t.en_transito,0),0) AS en_transito FROM bobs_coffee_final.v_stock_bajo s LEFT JOIN (SELECT d.id_insumo, SUM(d.cantidad_solicitada_base - COALESCE(r.recibido,0)) AS en_transito FROM bobs_coffee_final.detalle_orden d JOIN bobs_coffee_final.orden_compra o ON o.id_orden = d.id_orden LEFT JOIN (SELECT id_detalle, SUM(cantidad_recibida_base) AS recibido FROM bobs_coffee_final.detalle_recepcion GROUP BY id_detalle) r ON r.id_detalle = d.id_detalle WHERE o.estado IN ('EMITIDA','PARCIAL') GROUP BY d.id_insumo) t ON t.id_insumo = s.id_insumo ORDER BY s.stock_actual / s.stock_minimo;

SELECT
    o.id_orden,
    pr.nombre AS proveedor,
    i.nombre AS insumo,
    DATEDIFF(
        DATE('2026-11-14'),
        DATE_ADD(
            o.fecha_emision,
            INTERVAL ip.plazo_entrega_dias DAY
        )
    ) AS dias_atraso
FROM bobs_coffee_final.orden_compra o
JOIN bobs_coffee_final.proveedor pr
    ON pr.id_proveedor = o.id_proveedor
JOIN bobs_coffee_final.detalle_orden d
    ON d.id_orden = o.id_orden
JOIN bobs_coffee_final.insumo i
    ON i.id_insumo = d.id_insumo
JOIN bobs_coffee_final.insumo_proveedor ip
    ON ip.id_insumo = d.id_insumo
    AND ip.id_proveedor = o.id_proveedor
WHERE o.estado IN ('EMITIDA', 'PARCIAL')
  AND DATE_ADD(
      o.fecha_emision,
      INTERVAL ip.plazo_entrega_dias DAY
  ) < DATE('2026-11-14')
ORDER BY dias_atraso DESC;
